# DataDelve (Delvetek)

> Expert 1:1 data analytics and tech training. Delvetek runs cohort-based programs in data analysis, project management, business analysis, cybersecurity, software engineering, and data engineering.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Delvetek's training programs and mentorship model.
- [Free Webinar](/webinar): Free intro webinar for prospective students.
- [Enroll](/enroll): Enrollment tiers and pricing for the current cohort.
- [Case Studies](/case-studies): Real trainee projects across data, PM, BA, cybersecurity, and engineering.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on data analytics, tech careers, and training updates.
- [Ambassador Program](/ambassador): Referral / ambassador signup.

## Courses

- [Data Analysis](/courses/data-analysis): SQL, Excel, Power BI, Python for analytics.
- [Project Management](/courses/project-management): Agile, Scrum, Jira, delivery frameworks.
- [Business Analysis](/courses/business-analysis): Requirements, stakeholder mapping, BRDs.
- [Cybersecurity](/courses/cybersecurity): Network security, vulnerability assessment, compliance.
- [Software Engineering](/courses/software-engineering): Full-stack web development with modern frameworks.
- [Data Engineering](/courses/data-engineering): ETL pipelines, Python, Airflow, cloud warehouses.
